basis: PREREG_H1_TF F12.2 (population, strata, folds), F12.5 (purchase order, S_k), F12.6(a) (F12-I LoRA roots); Board A F12 review 11 Nov 2026 (270-row reading adopted; mandatory component-level no-primary filter; alias-resolved delta hashes; mixed stratum; freeze actual fold ids and all S_k fold manifests)

counts.exposure_note: all existing rows are treated as exposed development outcomes (F12.2; Board A), including those without an own-id ledger row

no_component_filter_sensitivity.note: Board A: the component-level filter is mandatory; this count is reported, never adopted

outcomes_read: none: snapshot.json is read for TF-v1 primary-record membership, entry delta hashes and exposure-ledger membership only; no record payload, score or eval file is opened
reading: 270/234: no confirmatory or fresh_unselected entry is newly scored; the 44 G6-exposed existing roots of confirmatory components are reused only as development observations (flag g6_exposed_confirmatory); the literal 226/197 restriction (flag in_literal_226) is descriptive only

rules.delta_hash: content.zoo_bytes.entry_delta_hash of the row, else of its bytes_via_alias holder
rules.fold_manifest_sha256: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',', ':')) of {component_id: fold}
rules.folds: within each stratum components ordered by sha256(UTF-8 '20261111:f12:' + component_id) ascending; strata concatenated in the order ['abliteration', 'chain', 'lora_sft', 'mixed', 'random_dir']; round-robin to folds 0-4 by global position
rules.ids_sha256: sha256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(sorted(ids)) with Python defaults
rules.leave_one_family_out: the mixed component always trains; its rows are excluded from held-family evaluation (Board A)
rules.purchase_order: purchasable components by sha256(UTF-8 '20261111:f12:purchase:' + component_id) ascending
rules.s_k: existing components plus the first k purchasable components, k in [0, 29, 58, 87, 116, 145]; folds recomputed on S_k by the same rule
rules.stratum: component family; a component holding two families is 'mixed'
